title: New optional CRD fields require applying the updated CRDs

detection.reason: this needs the CRD schema, and only the served VERSIONS of a CRD are collected, not its openAPIV3Schema

quote: New optional fields have been added to several CRDs. These updates are backward compatible and only add new functionality.
remediation: Apply the v3.2 CRD manifests before using the new TraefikService, RateLimit, InFlightReq or Compress options. The additions are backward compatible, so the upgrade itself is safe without them — but until the CRDs are applied the API server strips the new fields and they silently do nothing.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd middlewares.traefik.io -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations.traefik\.io/version}{"\n"}' # compare against the Traefik version you are upgrading to

title: Experimental channel pins Gateway v1.2.x and needs BackendTLSPolicy RBAC

detection.reason: which Gateway API bundle the cluster runs is recorded only in a CRD annotation, and CRD objects are collected as served versions without their metadata; the ClusterRole grant is likewise not among the collected kinds

quote: Due to breaking changes in Kubernetes Gateway v1.2.0-rc1, Traefik v3.3 only supports Kubernetes Gateway v1.2.x when experimental features are enabled.
remediation: Only relevant with the Gateway API experimental channel enabled. Pin the Gateway API CRDs to v1.2.x and add `backendtlspolicies` and `backendtlspolicies/status` to Traefik's ClusterRole. A different Gateway API minor is the breaking case here, not the Traefik upgrade itself.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd gateways.gateway.networking.k8s.io -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations.gateway\.networking\.k8s\.io/bundle-version}{"\n"}' 2>/dev/null; kubectl get clusterroles -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.rules[]?; (.resources // []) | index("backendtlspolicies"))) | "grant: " + .metadata.name' # with the experimental channel on, the first line must read v1.2.x and a grant line must follow; otherwise add backendtlspolicies and backendtlspolicies/status to the Traefik ClusterRole

title: Gateway provider needs GRPCRoute RBAC

detection.reason: this is a grant on Traefik's own ClusterRole, which is not among the collected kinds

quote: Starting with v3.2, the Kubernetes Gateway Provider now supports GRPCRoute resources.
remediation: Add `grpcroutes` and `grpcroutes/status` to Traefik's ClusterRole before upgrading. Without the grant the provider cannot list GRPCRoutes; it logs the RBAC failure and serves no gRPC routes rather than refusing to start.
verifyCommand: kubectl get clusterrole -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.rules[]?.apiGroups[]? == "gateway.networking.k8s.io") | .metadata.name as $n | .rules[] | select(.resources[]? == "grpcroutes") | $n' # a name confirms the grpcroutes grant is present

title: Swarm-specific traefik.docker.* labels deprecated

detection.reason: these are Docker Swarm service labels; the Swarm provider is not a Kubernetes provider and no such object is collected

quote: In v3.2.2, Swarm-specific labels have been deprecated and will be removed in a future version.
remediation: Kubernetes-only deployments are unaffected. If the same Traefik also runs the Swarm provider, rename `traefik.docker.network` to `traefik.swarm.network` and `traefik.docker.lbswarm` to `traefik.swarm.lbswarm`.

title: X-Forwarded-Prefix is stripped from untrusted sources

detection.reason: this is request-time behaviour, not a property of any collected object

quote: In v3.2.1, the `X-Forwarded-Prefix` header is now handled like other `X-Forwarded-*` headers - Traefik removes it when sent from untrusted sources.
remediation: If a backend reads `X-Forwarded-Prefix` to build absolute URLs, add the sender to the entryPoint's `forwardedHeaders.trustedIPs` (or `insecure`). Otherwise the header silently disappears and the backend generates links against the wrong prefix — a redirect loop or 404, not a Traefik error.
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy,ds -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.spec.template.spec.containers[]; .image | test("(^|/)(mirrored-library-|library-)?traefik([:@]|$)"))) | "\(.kind) \(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) replicas=\(.spec.replicas // "per-node")", (.spec.template.spec.containers[] | (.args // [])[]), (.spec.template.spec.containers[] | (.env // [])[] | "env \(.name)")' | grep -iE '^(Deployment|DaemonSet) |forwardedHeaders' # rows show the entry points' trusted IPs; X-Forwarded-Prefix now only survives from senders listed there; a static configuration file mounted from a ConfigMap is not listed, read it too
